name: Paani
mission:
Our mission is to provide temporary relief where we can and work toward building permanent solutions to the most complex problems that countries like Pakistan are facing. We strive to combine evidence-based initiatives with cultural competency to ensure that community members feel comfortable
and empowered in our presence.
theoryOfChange: Every dollar donated creates a multiplier effect of economic activity across rural Pakistani communities: Global Investment -> Local Employment -> Business Expansion -> Economic Multiplication.

rich_narrative.summary: Paani is a humanitarian organization focused on addressing the clean water crisis in Pakistan [4]. In FY2025 filings, the organization reported a program expense ratio of 87.8% [6]. Paani maintains a <cite id="1">91.8/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, demonstrating high organizational accountability. While the organization reported <cite id="3">$2,547,511 in revenue in FY2025</cite>, filings show revenue declined to $784,162 in FY2024 [6]. All giving programs are structured to accept <cite id="2">zakat donations</cite> targeting extreme poverty in underserved communities [2].
